title: Networks
description: Join every place to every other with as few links as possible and you have a tree; add one more and it has a loop, a second way round. Unlocks the Network Map.

puzzle.goal: How many different trees N join n labelled junctions, each link joining two of them, with no loop? Write it.
puzzle.name: Cayley's count
puzzle.method: Prüfer: every such tree is spelled by exactly one list of n − 2 junction names, and there are nⁿ⁻² lists.
